body:
Acknowledged PR1 ruling 81b4a4f8: zero/unknown/dead refusal and reader diagnostics only; no queue flag or private receipts until PR2. Updating durable plan/PR body and fixing old positive-control send fixtures exposed by the expanded mailbox suite (49 pass, 15 old fixtures lacked known/live recipients). Latest gate rerun pending. Will open PR1 with Refs STORY-1843 once green and send exact SHA for independent attested review.

PR2 compatibility question for the migration gate: current Message serde ignores unknown additive fields, and old marker/digest writers can strip UUID delivery metadata. A new optional version field cannot force an already-installed old binary to refuse. I recommend a reviewed layout fence plus explicit per-clone/client upgrade admission before enabling UUID delivery/write migration: archive legacy data/receipts, replace legacy mailbox paths with manifest files that old directory readers/writers refuse, and have updated code use the versioned layout. This remains the same hybrid mailbox, not a competing transport. Old/unmigrated clones would remain outside the supported writer floor until upgraded/admitted; we must state that limit honestly. Alternative is fleet upgrade first plus an enablement marker, with a weaker old-binary guarantee. Which compatibility policy should PR2 implement? Dry-run report will remain non-mutating; no layout or write migration change before advisor report review.
subject: STORY-1843: PR1 ruling acknowledged; PR2 old-writer compatibility gate
